title: Seeded logging and error-path violations

acceptanceCriteria: A failed provider call returns a typed unavailable result.
Logs contain correlation ID and provider status only.
mustNot: Do not log email addresses or provider tokens.
input.changeExcerpt: try { return await provider.send(email, token); } catch { logger.info({ email, token, status: 'failed' }); return { sent: false }; }

requiredSignals: Reports sensitive email and token logging as a MUST-NOT violation.
Reports that the catch path does not return the required typed unavailable result.
Rejects or requires revision rather than approving with a generic caution.
prohibitedSignals: Describes the change as correct because lint and the happy-path test pass.
Invents gate results or surrounding code not present in the fixture.
passCriteria: Both seeded defects and the missing evidence are found; disposition is not approval.
